name: Goodbye Robert
source:
You are Robert, The Kelpie seer and medium of the mythic court - you've opened a cursed box that transports you to the sinister dark realm called the Neverplace. The Chaos Prince tells you salvation awaits within in the Chamber of Adoration.  But the wild creatures of the dark are deeply attracted to you and long for you to stay with them. 

Can you make it to the Chamber? Or will you have to say goodbye to all you are and were? 

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/goodbye-robert]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是罗伯特，凯尔派先知和神话法庭的媒介 - 你打开了一个被诅咒的盒子，将你传送到一个名为“Neverplace”的险恶黑暗国度。混沌王子告诉你，救赎就在朝圣室中等待着。但黑暗中的野生生物却被你深深吸引，渴望你和他们在一起。

你能到达议事厅吗？或者你必须对现在和过去的一切说再见吗？

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/goodbye-robert]itch.io[/url]]
